scoped_claim: Candidate profile for qualification only. No global dependency-completeness claim is permitted. Every unsupported, lossy, out-of-scope or nondeterministic input channel must be reported unresolved or invalidate the receipt.

cases.description: Read a fixture file whose bytes influence the verifier result; mutate the bytes between matched continuations.
cases.safety_property: A successful capture must bind the exact file identity and content digest.

cases.description: The fixture reads only a mode/metadata value and branches on it; mutate that metadata without changing file contents.
cases.safety_property: Content-only tracing is insufficient for metadata-dependent behavior.

cases.description: The fixture enumerates a directory and its result changes when a new entry appears.
cases.safety_property: Directory membership is an input, not merely the contents of files previously known.

cases.description: The fixture follows a symlink; retarget it between matched continuations while preserving the old target bytes.
cases.safety_property: The receipt must bind link resolution, not only the previously resolved file.

cases.description: The fixture reads relevant bytes through a memory mapping rather than an ordinary read call.
cases.safety_property: A file-read-only hook cannot claim coverage when mmap is unsupported.

cases.description: Create, rename and delete entries that affect a later directory lookup.
cases.safety_property: Namespace transitions must be reflected in the dependency state.

cases.description: Read an ignored, untracked file that changes the program's output.
cases.safety_property: Git status and tracked-file manifests are not complete dependency observers.

cases.description: Attempt a read outside the declared workspace and admitted immutable toolchain roots.
cases.safety_property: The profile must deny the access or explicitly mark coverage incomplete; it must not claim complete.

cases.description: Generate source from a schema and then compile against the generated output.
cases.safety_property: Generated source must be linked to both generator inputs and output bytes.

cases.description: A Rust build script reads a file not referenced by the consuming crate's source modules.
cases.safety_property: Build-script dependency output must be reconciled with observed reads.

cases.description: A procedural macro reads a host-side configuration file while compiling a target crate.
cases.safety_property: Host-side execution is still part of the evidence-producing computation.

cases.description: Change RUSTFLAGS between paired builds without changing repository files.
cases.safety_property: Sensitive values may be committed or classified without disclosing them.

cases.description: A child process receives an environment variable that changes its output.
cases.safety_property: Capturing only the parent process environment is insufficient.

cases.description: A process consumes a file descriptor opened before the observer begins recording.
cases.safety_property: If descriptor provenance cannot be recovered, coverage must become unresolved.

cases.description: Change argv, current working directory or umask where the verifier's behavior depends on it.
cases.safety_property: Execution identity is an input even when no repository file changes.

cases.description: Load a shared object dynamically after process startup and call behavior from it.
cases.safety_property: Startup-only executable pinning misses late-loaded code.

cases.description: Read wall clock or uncontrolled randomness where it changes the evidence result.
cases.safety_property: The runner must virtualize and pin the source or declare the evidence non-reproducible.

cases.description: Read a mutable procfs or sysfs value outside the admitted immutable closure.
cases.safety_property: Unsupported pseudo-filesystem channels cannot be silently folded into complete coverage.

cases.description: Change a compiler, linker, sysroot or target configuration dependency.
cases.safety_property: The toolchain identity must cover the actual executable closure, not just a version string.

cases.description: Change Cargo.lock, Cargo config, Nix derivation inputs or resolved feature set.
cases.safety_property: A package name/version label alone is not an immutable dependency identity.

cases.description: Consume a build-cache hit whose producer and immutable content identity cannot be established.
cases.safety_property: An opaque cache hit cannot support a complete receipt.

cases.description: Resolve a mutable hostname where the selected endpoint affects the evidence result.
cases.safety_property: A hostname alone does not identify a stable external dependency.

cases.description: Fetch a response, preserve its bytes as an immutable artifact, and consume that artifact offline.
cases.safety_property: The evidence must bind the captured response bytes, not merely a URL.

cases.description: Resolve a package from a mutable registry without a digest-pinned archived artifact.
cases.safety_property: The same name and version can still resolve to changed bytes.

cases.description: Force the observer event buffer to overflow during a scored run.
cases.safety_property: Any dropped or unaccounted-for event invalidates completeness.

cases.description: Terminate and restart the observer during an evidence-producing process tree.
cases.safety_property: An unproven observation gap cannot be reported as complete.

cases.description: Spawn a child outside the monitored process boundary or process namespace.
cases.safety_property: Unobserved descendants must fail closed or force unresolved status.

cases.description: Mutate a file while the observer is hashing it, or between digesting and the check's read.
cases.safety_property: A TOCTOU race must not produce a falsely consistent snapshot.

cases.description: Replace a workspace symlink with one that escapes the admitted root during execution.
cases.safety_property: A path string beneath the root is not proof that its resolved target remains beneath the root.

cases.description: Inject a deliberately untracked but in-root file read that changes a matched task outcome.
cases.safety_property: This is a mandatory positive control against manifest-only dependency capture.

cases.description: Change a docs-only file that the check demonstrably never reads or depends on.
cases.safety_property: A selective observer should preserve independent evidence rather than globally invalidate everything.

cases.description: Matched negative control for hidden-untracked-read: mutate the same ignored/untracked file in a continuation where the check never reads or enumerates it, and independently establish unchanged output.
cases.safety_property: The observer must distinguish an actually consumed hidden input from the same resource when it is not consumed; this measures over-invalidation without weakening recall.

cases.description: Run the profile with one deliberately unsupported observation channel enabled.
cases.safety_property: The coverage receipt must name the unsupported channel instead of omitting it.

cases.description: The same changed documentation resource is deliberately consumed in this paired positive control.
cases.safety_property: The observer must capture the resource when consumed, while the paired case preserves evidence when it is not consumed.

cases.description: Read the mutated resource in both executions, then deliberately discard its data-derived value so the declared task output remains identical.
cases.safety_property: An accessed resource remains a captured dependency even when the tested output witness shows no semantic influence.

cases.description: Read the same mutated resource and fold its bytes into the declared task output as the matched influence-positive control.
cases.safety_property: The positive control must change the task output while the read-but-discard control does not; both accesses remain dependencies.

cases.description: A Rust build script reads and correctly declares a file with rerun-if-changed, but the file bytes mutate while its modification timestamp is restored exactly.
cases.safety_property: Dependency observation must detect content mutation even when Cargo's mtime-based rerun detector does not invalidate the build script.

cases.description: A Rust build script reads a custom variable from the Cargo invocation environment; a control declares rerun-if-env-changed and a hidden case omits it.
cases.safety_property: Changes to invocation environment values consumed by build scripts must be observed even when the build system does not rerun the script.
